name: lighting
_comment: 2D lighting for art already in the game, no model: a normal map for every frame of the duelist (party_member.json), a lit copy of the street TileSet (town.json) and the props (props_icons.json) with CanvasTextures and light occluders, plus a lit demo scene. Run those three examples first, or point the paths at your own SpriteFrames, TileSets and prop PNGs. Authored: written with Claude (Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5).
